title: Harnesses Expose Internal Storage Layout (`_inner._values`, `_positions`)
impact: `AccountHarness._validatorAtFull`, `EnumerableSetHarness._positionOf`, `DoubleEndedQueueHarness.begin/end` expose raw storage slots. Harmless in FV, but copying these accessors into production creates upgrade-layout coupling and griefing surface (e.g., `at_` on out-of-range index reverts — usable as a cheap DoS oracle in loops).
